title: Classic Audi Quattro S1 vs modern Audi R8!

author: carwow
description:
This would be the most expensive Carwow drag race of all time… If they were full-sized! 

Explore new and used car deals on Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-25-08

We’ve got our hands on a Porsche Speedster, a Ferrari 250 GT, a Series 1 Jaguar E-Type, and a Mercedes 300SL - but with a difference! 

Junior Cars lent us all four cars, and they’re miniature replicas of these world-famous sports cars! 

Each of the four cars comes with a steel chassis and fibreglass bodywork that replicates the original car. All four cars here are equipped with a 125cc single-cylinder engine that produces a total of 9hp, and all cars have a 3-speed sequential gearbox. All four cars are also Rear Wheel Drive only. 

So how will this one play out? The Ferrari, Jag and Mercedes have front-mounted engines, while the Porsche is rear-mounted - will that prove decisive? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

Thanks to https://www.instagram.com/junior_cars_uk for helping us to run this race
title: Ferrari 250GT v Jag E-Type v Porsche Speedster v Mercedes 300SL: DRAG RACE
